rules.condition: AXI read is legal: FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0-2, cache 0000/0001, no 4-KiB crossing
rules.statement: A legal AXI read (FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0–2, cache 0000/0001) must be supported and performed as APB transfers.

rules.condition: AXI read request is unsupported or crosses a 4-KiB boundary
rules.statement: The bridge must issue no APB transfer and return ARLEN+1 R beats with RRESP SLVERR.
A legal AXI write consists of an AW request followed by the declared number of W beats; W data may arrive before AW.
W beats may arrive before the AW request.
The bridge must issue no APB transfer, drain the W beats, then return a B response with SLVERR.
AXI protocol violations are outside the guaranteed profile, so bridge behavior is not guaranteed for them.
The bridge must perform one APB transfer per AXI beat.

rules.condition: PREADY never rises during the access phase
rules.statement: The bridge must hold the APB access indefinitely and not time out.
The bridge must sample PSLVERR on the completed APB transfer.
The bridge must return the read beat with RRESP SLVERR, treating read data as invalid.
The bridge must accumulate the write error and report it in BRESP.
The external default Completer must respond with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1, and the bridge must then return AXI SLVERR.
A missing default responder for unmapped addresses is an integration violation and must not occur.

rules.condition: burst request crosses a 4-KiB address boundary
rules.statement: The bridge must reject the request before issuing any APB traffic.
A burst must not cross a 4-KiB address boundary.
The baseline bridge has no interrupt port.
